title: Probability and Market-Threshold Interface with No-Trade Gate
mission: Expose calibrated Tmax probabilities and a conservative decision interface without altering the forecasting model or leaking market outcomes.
steps: Map continuous calibrated distribution to exact settlement buckets/thresholds.
Record market snapshot time separately from weather cutoff.
Calculate implied probability, model probability, uncertainty and margin of safety.
Implement no-trade when calibration, liquidity, spread, source freshness or edge thresholds fail.
Do not use future market prices or settlement to train weather features.
Backtest only after forecasting confirmation and with exact historical price vintages.
db_objects: live probability outputs and decision logs
acceptance: No automatic trade execution unless separately authorized
failure: Missing exact market history: do not fabricate trading backtest
